memory_candidates: Lean's linter.style.longFile baseline must EQUAL the file's own round-up to the next hundred, not a forward-looking ceiling: a baseline set above that round-up emits 'The current limit is N, but it is expected to be M' and introduces a build warning. A growing file therefore needs its baseline bumped incrementally per phase rather than set once to a projected final value.

A Nat.find over a Bool-valued predicate (e.g. pend (objAt g (a - j)) = false) is decidable without Classical.choice, so an extraction lemma built on it stays at [propext, Quot.sound] even when the proof opens a classical scope that is never consumed. Check #print axioms rather than assuming classical implies Classical.choice.

In this repository, any commit that changes a .lean file's line count stales typst/generated/status.typ's formalsystem-line-count / tests-line-count fields and is refused by git-commit-scoped.sh's pre-commit typst-sync gate. The sanctioned remedy is bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix plus staging that file in the same commit.
